goal: Customize validation and normalization of the postal code and phone on saved customer addresses.

absentMeans.description: The platform uses the standard normalization and validation for the supplied address policy.

whyThisDefault: Hosts can choose address formats required by their delivery integrations while preserving existing behavior by default.

frozenOn: Existing saved addresses and captured delivery destinations keep their stored values.

runtime.reason: The callbacks are executable host code.

goal: Change how checkout shipping rates and quote promotions are calculated or connect a shipping carrier (carrier, shipping provider, courier, rate calculation).
whyThisDefault: When the optional resolveQuoteShippingPromotions callback property on DbBackedCommerceQuotePortDeps from @openlup/platform/pricing is omitted, createDbBackedCommerceQuotePort uses shippingFlatMinor if supplied (omitting quote shipping fields when shippingFlatMinor is also absent) and still runs resolveAutomaticQuotePromotions and applyPromotionCodesV2 (including shipping discounts).

effect.appliesTo: New checkout quotes call the optional resolveQuoteShippingPromotions callback property on DbBackedCommerceQuotePortDeps from @openlup/platform/pricing (for example composed via createQuoteShippingPromotions from @openlup/platform/promotions) during quote calculation.
frozenOn: Saved checkout quotes and order drafts retain their recorded shipping amounts and terms.

runtime.reason: The callback is executable server code bound as the optional resolveQuoteShippingPromotions property on DbBackedCommerceQuotePortDeps from @openlup/platform/pricing (for example via createQuoteShippingPromotions from @openlup/platform/promotions).

goal: Set the legacy flat shipping fee in currency minor units when threshold shipping policy is absent (flat shipping, legacy shipping rate, delivery fee).
whyThisDefault: Zero minor units preserves the historical absent-row fallback in commerce_settings and quoteShippingPolicy when neither a flat rate nor a threshold shipping policy is configured.

effect.appliesTo: Legacy flat-rate fallback read from commerce_settings.value_minor (and managed via ShippingRateDataPort). Used only when no active shipping-policy.v1 threshold policy is supplied; ignored when threshold shipping policy such as the starter's offer.shippingMinor (shipping-policy.v1) is active.
frozenOn: Saved checkout quotes and order drafts retain their recorded shipping amounts and terms.

runtime.reason: Updated through ShippingRateDataPort.setShippingFlatMinor when threshold shipping policy is not active.

goal: Define v2 checkout destination address rules for each market and country, including required subdivision, postal format and delivery classifications.

absentMeans.description: Versioned destination validation requires a matching host policy. Managed hosts support v1 checkout and saved addresses. Fresh v2 destination issuance requires a native writer. Use the v1 address book for saved addresses.

whyThisDefault: The application owns the destination rules for its markets and delivery services.

effect.appliesTo: New versioned destination submissions use the selected policy revision.
frozenOn: Previously captured destinations keep their recorded address and policy revision.

runtime.reason: Version and bind AddressPolicyV1 data in server composition. Discover v2 destination issuance with destinationV2Capabilities.

goal: Support optional postal codes and address regions.

runtime.reason: The native address contract requires a postal code and has no region field.

goal: Configure the allowed payment method preference codes accepted when customers save a payment preference (payment method preferences, saved payment methods, payment preference vocabulary).
whyThisDefault: The three built-in payment method kinds preserve the historical customer_payment_preferences vocabulary when no shipping_payment_method_preferences row is installed.

effect.appliesTo: New payment preference writes in customer_preference_save read key='shipping_payment_method_preferences' from public.commerce_settings via shipping_payment_method_preferences_read(). The table CHECK constraint enforces the lowercase identifier format ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$, while customer_preference_save enforces membership in the active configured list on writes. When absent, the SQL reader defaults to instant, card, and transfer; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 shipping_payment_method_preferences_policy_invalid.
frozenOn: Historical customer_payment_preferences rows remain readable through customer_preferences_read, customer_preferences_export, and customer_default_address_hints even after a method kind is removed from the active list.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installShippingPaymentMethodPreferencesPolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and methodKinds. Revision must be a nonblank string and methodKinds a non-empty array of 1 through 32 unique codes matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$.
